Lessons.Title: Graphs of Polynomial Functions
ExplanationParagraphs: Learning goals: distinguish smooth polynomial graphs from graphs with corners or discontinuities, factor to find zeros, recognize multiplicities, determine tails and turning-point bounds, sketch graphs and apply the Intermediate Value Theorem.
Polynomial p(x)=a∏(x−r)^m describes zeros and their multiplicities: odd m crosses the x-axis, even m touches it.
The leading coefficient and parity of total degree govern tails. A degree n polynomial has at most n−1 turning points; these are limits, not guaranteed counts.
When a continuous polynomial changes sign across an interval, the Intermediate Value Theorem guarantees at least one root inside, without claiming its exact position.
Construct a formula by multiplying factors corresponding to roots and use a known y-intercept or another coordinate to determine the scale a.
For optimization, compare all critical points in the physical interval plus endpoints; a local extremum alone may not be globally optimal.
Independent Edulytics Cool-down: (a) Describe end behavior and root multiplicity of −(x−2)²(x+1). (b) Show x³−x−1 has a zero in (1,2). (c) Construct a quadratic with double zero at3 and y-intercept8.
Independent Try It 1 — Root/axis intercepts. Find all real x-intercepts of p(x)=x⁴−10x²+9 and y-intercept.
Independent Try It 2 — Use multiplicity graph. A polynomial has simple zero x=−2, double zero x=1, another simple zero x=3. Explain crossing/touching.
Independent Try It 3 — Sketch given factors. Sketch p(x)=x(x−1)⁴(x+3)³ and classify tails.
Independent Try It 4 — Apply IVT with sign change. Show p(x)=x³−2x−2 has a real zero between x1 and x2.
Independent Try It 5 — Build from a graph description. A degree3 polynomial crosses at x=−1, touches at x=2 and passes through (0,8). Find lowest-degree formula.
Independent Try It 6 — Local extrema on interval. For f(x)=x³−3x on [−2,2], find global max/min including endpoints.

KeyConcepts.Title: Polynomial graph continuity
KeyConcepts.Definition: Polynomials are continuous at every real input.
KeyConcepts.Rule: No finite jumps, gaps or vertical asymptotes.

KeyConcepts.Title: Smoothness
KeyConcepts.Definition: Polynomial graphs have derivatives of all orders.

KeyConcepts.Title: Root factorization
KeyConcepts.Rule: Find real x-intercepts from factored p(x).

KeyConcepts.Title: Multiplicity
KeyConcepts.Rule: Even m touches, odd m crosses.

KeyConcepts.Title: Leading term tails
KeyConcepts.Definition: Degree parity and sign of leading coefficient determine end behavior.

KeyConcepts.Title: Y-intercept
KeyConcepts.Rule: Often use it to determine unknown scalar factor.

KeyConcepts.Title: Polynomial turning-point bound
KeyConcepts.Definition: Degree n polynomial has at most n−1 turning points.
KeyConcepts.Rule: No claim that maximum number must occur.

KeyConcepts.Title: Intermediate Value Theorem
KeyConcepts.Definition: A continuous function whose values at a and b have opposite signs has a zero in (a,b).

KeyConcepts.Title: Polynomial reconstruction
KeyConcepts.Definition: Use zeros, multiplicities and a known nonzero point to determine scale.

KeyConcepts.Title: Local versus global extrema
KeyConcepts.Definition: Local maxima/minima can differ from interval-wide extrema.
KeyConcepts.Rule: Check interval endpoints and interior critical points.

SummaryPoints: Polynomial graph is continuous and smooth.
Real zeros and multiplicities arise from factors.
Odd roots cross; even roots touch.
IVT detects at least one zero between opposite signs.

CommonMistakes.Mistake: Thinking every zero corresponds to a crossing.
CommonMistakes.WhyWrong: Even-multiplicity roots touch and reverse direction.

CommonMistakes.Mistake: Treating IVT as finding an exact root.
CommonMistakes.WhyWrong: It only guarantees existence between opposite signs.
CommonMistakes.Correction: Use factorization or numerical root method for exact/approximate value.

CommonMistakes.Mistake: Using only critical points in constrained optimization.
CommonMistakes.WhyWrong: A boundary value may be greater/smaller.
CommonMistakes.Correction: Check both endpoints and valid interior critical points.
